openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.description: Portfolio source and public code presence built around modular React and TypeScript components.

projects.title: checkyollama
projects.description: VS Code extension for Ollama Modelfiles with TextMate grammar, LSP-style hover docs, real-time diagnostics, and CI via GitHub Actions.

details.mission: A published VS Code extension that brings language-server-style tooling to Ollama Modelfiles — syntax highlighting, hover documentation, and real-time diagnostics.
implementationDetails: Authored a TextMate grammar for Ollama Modelfile syntax and wired it into the VS Code extension host.
Implemented LSP-style hover providers and a real-time diagnostics engine using the VS Code API.
Set up CI with GitHub Actions to lint, test, and package the extension on every push.
details.keyTakeaways: End-to-end ownership from grammar authoring to Marketplace publication, with a real test suite and CI pipeline.

projects.title: Sororine
projects.description: Full-stack safety intelligence platform built with Next.js, Prisma, SQLite, and stateless JWT sessions.

details.mission: Full-stack safety intelligence platform built with Next.js App Router and TypeScript, featuring API routes, an ORM-backed data layer, and stateless JWT-secured sessions.
implementationDetails: Built the application with Next.js App Router and TypeScript.
Added Prisma-backed persistence with SQLite for a lightweight data layer.
Implemented stateless JWT sessions and geospatial risk scoring for incident aggregation.
details.keyTakeaways: Delivered a secure product-focused platform with a compact data stack and clear session boundaries.

projects.title: SleeQC
projects.description: Adaptive embedded security prototype for ESP32-S3 using TensorFlow Lite and resource-aware profile switching.

details.mission: Resource-adaptive post-quantum cryptography system built for an ESP32-S3 edge device.
implementationDetails: Prototyped a resource-adaptive post-quantum cryptography system on an ESP32-S3.
Deployed a TensorFlow Lite decision engine to monitor runtime metrics.
Switched between security profiles automatically based on device conditions.
details.keyTakeaways: The prototype demonstrated the feasibility of deploying adaptive security solutions on resource-constrained edge devices.

projects.title: Nucleotide Transformer Quantization
projects.description: NF4 4-bit quantization of a 2.5B genomics model reducing VRAM from 4.76 GB to 1.46 GB with 0.99 cosine similarity preserved.

details.mission: Applied NF4 4-bit quantization to InstaDeepAI's 2.5B Nucleotide Transformer to make genomics-scale LLMs accessible on consumer hardware.
implementationDetails: Quantized a 2.5B parameter genomics model to NF4 4-bit precision using bitsandbytes.
Reduced peak VRAM from 4.76 GB to 1.46 GB — a 69% reduction — while retaining 0.99 cosine similarity to the original embeddings.
Published weights to HuggingFace with a reproducible notebook; the model has 50+ downloads.
details.keyTakeaways: Demonstrated that aggressive quantization can preserve embedding fidelity on domain-specific biological language models.

projects.title: CivicLink
projects.description: MERN stack civic governance platform connecting citizens to local government services and issue reporting.

details.mission: Civic governance platform built on the MERN stack, enabling citizens to report issues and engage with local government services.
implementationDetails: Built the full stack with MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js.
Implemented issue reporting, status tracking, and role-based access for citizens and administrators.
Designed a RESTful API layer with authenticated routes and structured data models.
details.keyTakeaways: Demonstrated end-to-end MERN ownership across auth, data modeling, and a consumer-facing React frontend.

projects.title: PulseGuard
projects.description: ESP8266-based PPG sensor pipeline streaming heart rate data to InfluxDB with Grafana time-series dashboards.

details.mission: End-to-end biosignal pipeline from an ESP8266 PPG sensor to InfluxDB time-series storage and Grafana visualization.
implementationDetails: Wired a PPG sensor to an ESP8266 and streamed raw heart rate data over Wi-Fi.
Ingested the data stream into InfluxDB for time-series storage.
Built a Grafana dashboard for real-time heart rate visualization and alerting.
details.keyTakeaways: Demonstrated a complete hardware-to-dashboard IoT pipeline with real biosignal data.
